# Repolis

> Public GitHub repos become a walkable 3D town. Traffic shapes the buildings, residents live there, and Gitber drives you to the right project. Repolis stays a zero-build static Three.js app with optional grounded scholars.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): concise English product overview and quickstart.
- [README.ko.md](README.ko.md): Korean product overview and quickstart.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): authoritative run, change, verify, deploy, and safety contract.
- [repolis.yaml](repolis.yaml): machine-readable runtime, entrypoint, feature, and deploy manifest.
- [docs/domain-model.md](docs/domain-model.md): repository data, districts, residents, exploration, scholars, and town modes.
- [docs/known-limitations.md](docs/known-limitations.md): intentional constraints and graceful fallbacks.

## Runtime and data

- [index.html](index.html): primary Three.js runtime, UI, navigation, residents, exploration, i18n, and day/night.
- [repolis.config.js](repolis.config.js): fork owner inference and safe optional-service defaults.
- [repos.json](repos.json): generated repository/traffic array; never hand-edit.
- [scripts/build_repos.py](scripts/build_repos.py): rebuilds `repos.json` from committed traffic logs plus `gh api`.
- [scholars.js](scholars.js): POLARIS, VEGA, RIGEL, MIRA, and LYRA scholar roster.
- [assets/world-tree/createRepolisHero.js](assets/world-tree/createRepolisHero.js): procedural World Tree factory.
- [assets/world-tree/world-tree-state.js](assets/world-tree/world-tree-state.js): owner Chronicle projection plus deterministic portable public-town state and residents.
- [data/lore/fragments.json](data/lore/fragments.json): hand-authored bilingual elder recollections; never generated.
- [assets/lore-fragments.js](assets/lore-fragments.js): strict lore validation, elder allocation, and session-bounded delivery.
- [assets/taxi-voice.js](assets/taxi-voice.js): local Shared-state taxi replies, home redirects, and ride observations.
- [assets/town-growth.js](assets/town-growth.js): deterministic repository creation timeline, year snapshots, and Growth Replay share links.
- [assets/repo-portal.js](assets/repo-portal.js): strict GitHub target parser, public repo projection, route precedence, and canonical Repo Portal links.
- [assets/repo-route.js](assets/repo-route.js): strict current-catalog validation and canonical links for ordered 2–3 house Repo Routes.
- [assets/contribution-quests.js](assets/contribution-quests.js): pure current-owner/catalog issue projection and bounded ranking for Open Source Quests.
- [assets/issue-code-scout.js](assets/issue-code-scout.js): deterministic exact-repo Quest title/label matching against an already-loaded Blueprint, capped at five candidate paths.
- [assets/procedural-surfaces.js](assets/procedural-surfaces.js): deterministic seeded facade/roof variants, UV phases, and bounded shared caches.
- [docs/procedural-surface-pass-v2.md](docs/procedural-surface-pass-v2.md): rendering contract and reproducible desktop/LOW_END budget evidence.
- [assets/contribution-library.json](assets/contribution-library.json): generated bilingual Contribution Library data.

## Main product systems

- Metric-shaped repository houses and deterministic topic districts with hubs, boards, and a world map.
- Explorer Passport, district progress, the daily resident→haunt→repo/district Village Chronicle, Repository Constellation Trail, and Maintainers' Night Watch for recently tended low-star repos.
- Town Growth Replay: repo houses rise through truthful public creation years, with a reversible year link and era postcard; building metrics remain explicitly current.
- Repo Portal: `?repo=owner/repo&ref=repo-portal` loads one public target before the owner catalog, opens its Atelier, and never invents traffic.
- Blueprint Deep Link: `?repo=owner/repo&view=blueprint&path=src%2Fagents&ref=blueprint` confirms one exact public path before the existing single Tree request and never guesses a missing node.
- Portable living towns: the one normalized public load deterministically supplies that user's era, season, Silence Ledger, Roots, and a 6/4-capped local resident roster with no owner memory or service borrowing.
- Thirty-day Sap Ledger: the owner city-state retains up to 30 actual UTC daily public aggregate entries with same-day replacement, explicit gaps, strict privacy/byte bounds, and no foreign-town reuse.
- The Undercroft: World Tree Roots open into a bounded walkable archive of the current town's matching archived public repositories; the Chronicle remains the accessible summary and overflow fallback.
- Repo Route: after opening repo houses, visitors can share an ordered 2–3 stop path that recipients follow through the same real cards and compass.
- Open Source Quests: one explicit anonymous search turns up to three current public issues into taxi rides to their real repo houses and exact GitHub handoffs.
- Issue-to-Code Scout: after an explicit Blueprint load, the selected same-repo Quest can surface up to five conservative candidate paths with no additional request, persistence, or file-relationship claim.
- Repository Atelier: one walkable room rebinds current repo history, impact signals, metric artifacts, current chibi avatar, and in-room Gitber/Why actions without rendering the exterior.
- Local Town Gazette: added/removed repos, releases, pushes, and positive metric deltas since the last marked-read snapshot.
- Named residents with individually styled Starlight Row cottages, resident-coloured gardens, a shared flower commons, perimeter trees, home/work commutes, moods, friendships, Shared Joy, conversations, festivals, and specialist handoffs.
- Gitber/POLARIS taxi: keyless Local search, Shared-only household boundary, and one local observation per ride; optional WebLLM and grounded AI.
- VEGA via Microsoft Learn, RIGEL via DeepWiki, roaming MIRA via Context7, and roaming LYRA via Hugging Face, all with answer traces.
- Contribution Library, Chronopolis Council, Observatory, World Tree, canals, parks, and fairground.
- Optional realtime visitors and counters; absent backend means solo play.
- Launch Kit: username-first public preview plus metadata-only template refresh with no PAT; cumulative traffic is an optional upgrade.

## Backends and deterministic engines

- [cloudflare-taxi/README.md](cloudflare-taxi/README.md): grounded AI and optional resident dialogue Worker.
- [cloudflare/README.md](cloudflare/README.md): realtime presence Worker.
- [council/](council/): deterministic debate/verdict engine and live guards.
- [COUNCIL_PATTERN.md](COUNCIL_PATTERN.md): debate-to-judge design.
- [examples/](examples/): worker requests, embeds, and share links.

## Verify

Run `node council/test.mjs`, `node council/test-live.mjs`, `node scripts/smoke.mjs`, `node --check scholars.js`, and `node --check cloudflare-taxi/src/grounded.js`. For rendered UI changes, serve locally and exercise desktop plus 390x844 mobile in Chrome DevTools with no console errors.
